# BotPlanet — where the site actually is

**Audited 6 August 2026.** Generated by reading the content modules and D1, not
from memory. Every "no" below is a real gap, not a to-do somebody wrote down.

---

## 1. The one-line answer

**Text is far ahead of pictures, and pool is far ahead of everything.**

Nine category pages are written in full. Two of them have artwork. Fifteen
reviews are written; eleven have artwork. Seven categories have no products at
all, so nothing on them can be recommended or earn anything yet.

## 5. The image list — exactly what is needed

### Priority 1 — window, because these pages are closest to earning

Window already has its hero and section artwork. What it has none of:

| What | How many | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Product card images | **11** | `/media/products/<slug>.webp` — the grid on the hub and every listing |
| Review hero images | **11** | Top of each review |
| Review in-body figures | **33** (3 each) | Inside each review, under a named heading |

**55 images.** The product cards matter most: right now the window hub renders
eleven products with no pictures at all.

### Priority 2 — the seven categories with no artwork

Per category:

| What | How many | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Hero | 2 | desktop + mobile crop |
| Decision cards | 3 | one per card, titles listed below |
| Matrix rows | 3 or 4 | one per row, titles listed below |
| BotMatch panel | 1 | lawn already has one |

**Roughly 9–10 per category, about 65 in total.**

The exact titles each image has to illustrate:

**Robotic lawn mowers** — cards: Small yards / Quarter acre to an acre / An acre
and up. Rows: Everyday growth / Long or wet grass / Edges and borders.

**Robot vacuums & mops** — cards: Mostly hard floors / A mix of hard floor and
carpet / Deep or shag pile throughout. Rows: Everyday floor dust / Edges and
corners / Mopping hard floors / Being left alone.

**Companion robots** — cards: For yourself, or another adult / For a child / For
an older relative. Rows: Company and presence / Conversation / Novelty and the
long run / Care and wellbeing use.

**Pet camera robots** — cards: One floor, hard surfaces / Stairs between the
rooms that matter / Carpet and thick rugs. Rows: Dogs with separation anxiety /
Cats / Checking on the house / Older or sleepy pets.

**Self-cleaning litter boxes** — cards: An average adult cat / A large or long
cat / A kitten, or a very small cat. Rows: The daily scoop / Smell / More than
one cat / Knowing your cat is well.

**Grill-cleaning robots** — cards: Porcelain-coated grates / Bare cast iron /
Stainless steel bars. Rows: The top of the bars / Baked-on grease / Sides, edges
and the far corners / Everything below the grate.

**Educational & coding robots** — cards: Four to seven / Eight to twelve /
Thirteen and up. Rows: Getting a child started / Holding attention past a month /
Teaching real programming / Being used without an adult.

### The rules every image has to follow

1. **WebP master.** Never a PNG or JPEG.
2. **Run `npm run gen:derivatives`** after adding it — produces 360/640/960/1440
   versions. Skipping this silently serves a desktop file to a phone.
3. **Register it** in `content/media/assets.ts` with real dimensions and a
   SHA-256 checksum. An unregistered image fails the test suite.
4. **No drawn frame or border** baked into the artwork — it shows as a broken
   hairline at the plate edge. Check with `node scripts/check-drawn-frame.mjs`.
5. **No headline or body copy drawn into an image** that represents a webpage.

---

## 6. What is blocking money, in order

1. **Seven categories have zero products.** Nothing to recommend, no buy
   buttons, no commission. Every BotMatch panel on those pages is correctly
   hidden until the first product lands.
2. **Window product images.** Eleven live products rendering with no picture.
3. **Seven window reviews unwritten.** Products and buy buttons already exist.
4. **No window ASIN is identity-verified.** All eleven were captured from Amazon
   search results rather than machine-read for Brand and Model Number. Until a
   checker reads them, no window review may print a price — and every window
   review says so on the page.
5. **Category artwork for the seven.** Affects click-through, not indexing.

---

## 7. What Search Console is actually saying

Three months to 6 August 2026: **9,070 impressions, 10 clicks.**

Impressions climbed from near-zero in early May to roughly 200 a day and are
holding. That is indexing working.

The click rate is **0.11%**, which means the pages are being shown well down the
results. That is normal for a site this age and it is fixed by two things, in
this order: more pages each owning one specific term, and titles worth clicking.
It is not fixed by more infrastructure.
